name: ntfy push
summary: Sends alerts to your phone through the free ntfy app. Its check only asks ntfy.sh whether it answers; nothing is sent to your phone.

settings.label: Topic: a long random name only you know, 16+ characters (topics are public: anyone who guesses it reads your alerts)
Include details in alerts (figures, names, AI text). Off: titles only, since ntfy.sh keeps messages 12 hours unencrypted
